hypothesis: The unfavorable pair-specific development comparison is stable to matched count-scale preparation and source-selected strong/residual-enriched gene panels
evidence_level: post-outcome exploratory development; no fresh confirmation
sources: Existing qualified genetic count/log2 banks, and saved Stage1 genetic/EmeraldBay fitting predictions. Historical evaluators and calibration blocks excluded.
information: Measured exact matched singles, source pair responses for fitting and diagnostic panel selection; query pair responses only for final diagnostic scoring. No external priors or additional neural candidates.
qualification: Before candidate scores, verify common target, pair, gene and original development/query identities; matching raw-source hashes, normalizers, QC and control/single gene selection; preserve raw data and unresolved redistribution terms.
splits: Reuse the exact three random and three partner Stage1 outer/inner genetic partitions, with seed20261007. Six count folds per source. Existing log2 and EmeraldBay models are not refit or reselected.
reference: Retain additivity. Source-inner-selected simple chooses mean residual/global correction/summed-single kernel. Count and log raw MSEs are not numerically comparable.
panels: For each outer fold, all genes; strong: top ceiling(10% of genes) by mean absolute source pair effect; residual-enriched low-single proxy: source single mean absolute magnitude at or below the gene median, then top ceiling(10% of genes) by mean absolute source residual. Deterministic gene-index tie breaking; no query effect in panel selection. No claim of validated emergent biology.
technical: Reconstruct the original full-reference-selected global correction on each disjoint technical half, evaluate against the opposite half on each fixed source panel. Preserve whole shared single/control reference matrices. Report residual error, direction cosine and main/residual/cross-term accounting; frozen QC and full-reference selection prevent biological independence claims.
partner_reporting: Recover explicit held target sets from identity-only partner_splits with the original seed; verify saved folds exactly. Separate one/two held-target occurrences, counts, pairwise fold intersection and repeated-query coverage. No average-prediction replacement of the per-occurrence endpoint.
endpoint: Equal-condition per-occurrence panel MSE, paired crossed-target or whole-state diagnostic intervals; total-gene endpoint remains primary. Count gate at least5% relative improvement and positive diagnostic lower bound, separately per scale/split; panel findings cannot override a primary failure.
uncertainty: 2000 paired crossed-target/whole-state draws, fixed panels/profiles/shared references and selections; no biological, panel-selection or refitting confidence
decision: Report all scales/panels and effects. A favorable count-only development result remains experimental and must survive independent confirmation; no neural grid enlargement or automatic state/risk/scaling advancement.
